query: What consent, privacy, and data-governance procedures are required for passive adherence monitoring and linkage to EHR/refill data across participating sites?

response.query: What consent, privacy, and data-governance procedures are required for passive adherence monitoring and linkage to EHR/refill data across participating sites?
response.answer: For passive adherence monitoring and linkage to EHR/refill data, obtain informed consent from participants, comply with HIPAA Privacy Rule, and ensure data governance protocols are in place.

results.title: Healthcare Data Privacy & Security in 2026 | Strategic Management
results.content: # Healthcare Data Privacy and Security: Avoiding Costly Mistakes in 2026. As healthcare organizations embrace digital innovation, the risks to healthcare data privacy have grown significantly. In 2024, the average cost of a healthcare data breach was nearly $10 million—the highest of any industry. In this blog post, we explore what healthcare data privacy means, including:. By understanding and implementing data privacy best practices, you can avoid costly mistakes, ensure compliance, and protect your patients in an increasingly complex environment. ## **Understanding the Foundations of Healthcare Data Privacy**. Before diving into legal frameworks and prevention strategies, it’s essential to understand what data privacy actually means in a healthcare context—and why it is so critical. Healthcare data privacy refers to the protection of patients’ Protected Health Information (PHI). For healthcare organizations, this means securing systems, policies, and procedures to prevent unauthorized access and misuse of patient information.
